codeReview.summary: Feature skel-retrospective-and-seal implements M2/M3 retrospective authoring and seal verifications. Retrospective document (docs/plans/tui-redesign/retrospective.md) contains 10 findings with Recommendation: lines (exceeds ≥5 requirement). Marketing string cleanup correctly replaces 'review git diff' with 'check test status' in M3-specific test data and demo binaries. Staticcheck QF1003 fixed via tagged switch in cockpit.go. Unused field removed. Formatting normalized across 5 files. go.mod pin at v0.11.0 confirmed. No off-limits paths modified. TUI race tests pass. golangci-lint clean.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Skill tui-engineer-worker's VAL-CROSS-002 verification step calls for running bin/foxctl_tui -smoke-agent and -smoke-console, but the worker transcript shows no smoke test execution. The worker's verification commands are limited to go test (unit tests) and golangci-lint. This is reasonable given the feature was a cleanup/hygiene pass rather than a feature implementation, but the verification gap means VAL-CROSS-002 schema compatibility is not explicitly confirmed by this feature's work.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification.commandsRun lists go test, grep go.mod, git diff --stat, and golangci-lint. No smoke test invocation. VAL-CROSS-002 requires -smoke-agent / -smoke-console produce schema-compatible output.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Skill tui-engineer-worker's VAL-CROSS-008 verification step calls for the tuistory skill to run the full primary flow 3 times deterministically within 60s. The worker did not run tuistory. Given that this feature was a hygiene/cleanup pass (marketing string removal, lint fixes) and the preconditions state 'all other M3 features have landed', the worker relied on prior feature work to cover VAL-CROSS-008. This is a reasonable interpretation but leaves no explicit evidence that the end-to-end flow was verified after the final commit.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification.commandsRun has no tuistory or end-to-end flow commands. Only go test -race and golangci-lint were run post-commit.

sharedStateObservations.observation: shell_state.go (pre-M3 legacy shell code) contains EpicStatus: 'READY' which is a marketing string in scope for VAL-CROSS-001. The worker correctly limited VAL-CROSS-001 grep to M3-specific paths (detail_pane_snapshot_test.go, detailpane/main.go, detailpane-populated.txt) and did not touch legacy shell files. However, shell_state.go was not modified and still contains the 'READY' string. Since shell_state.go is in internal/interfaces/tui/ and is legacy (not M3) code, this is correctly scoped — but it means VAL-CROSS-001 is only partially addressed for the broader TUI package.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Grep of internal/interfaces/tui/ for 'READY|Codex / gpt-5.4|review git diff' shows hits in shell_state.go:31, shell_state_test.go:16-17 (EpicStatus: 'READY') and live_state.go:117 (Summary containing 'review git diff'). These files predate the M3 mission and were not modified.
